For reference, the original design specified 88 cells; adding 10 cells would bring the machine close to the original design intent. The original magnet design used in all solenoids from the injector to the accelerator exit has a major design flaw. The solenoid coil has many layers of square 13-gauge copper conductor. The mounting of the solenoid is faulty, causing turn-to-turn shorts in the coil at one end, as described in LA-UR-19-25841 [Jaworski, 2019].
